scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @sfera/shared && npm run build -w @sfera/db && npm run build -w @sfera/judge0 && npm run build -w @sfera/queue
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w @sfera/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @sfera/shared && npm run dev -w @sfera/web
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w @sfera/worker
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @sfera/api && npm run build -w @sfera/worker && npm run build -w @sfera/web
scripts.seed:problems: npm run build:libs && npm run seed:problems -w @sfera/api
scripts.seed:admin: npm run build:libs && npm run seed:admin -w @sfera/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/judge0/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/worker/tsconfig.test.json
